claims.text: LDA and Gibbs sampling were applied to evaluate ISWC and WWW conference publications from 2013-2017, focusing on discovering trends and relationships between topics and paper features.
Gibbs sampling was used to estimate and infer parameters of LDA, aiding in the analysis of publication data from the conferences.
The study involved extracting abstracts and titles from ISWC and WWW publications to implement LDA and analyze topic models.
